values: Third Weak Lefschetz Property for Arrangement Jacobian Quotients / OWR-4990374-005 (30004602): every finite central arrangement of distinct hyperplanes in K^3 over a characteristic-zero field has 3-WLP for its standard-graded Jacobian quotient.

Existing publication: Simone Marchesi, Elisa Palezzato and Michele Torielli, Lefschetz properties and the Jacobian algebra of 3-dimensional hyperplane arrangements, Port. Math. 83 (2026), no. 1/2, 1–18; published online 27 November 2025. Journal Theorems 4.7/4.10, together with the two-variable WLP-to-3-WLP bridge, cover the full original characteristic-zero question, including nonessential arrangements. Same-work preprint arXiv:2310.17794v1 (26 October 2023), DOI 10.48550/arXiv.2310.17794; use one publication row. Proof qualification: printed Corollary 3.7 is false (Q=xyz(x+y+z), p=2, N=K(-3)), and the blanket equality p=D−m−2 is invalid in general. PR #1207 supplies a complete correction using p≤D−m−2 and valid split/unstable/semistable threshold overlap with dual shift D−i−4; independently checked for the full target. The correction is AI assisted, unrefereed, and is not an author-approved erratum or journal acceptance. No new theorem, target counterexample, positive-characteristic or strong-Lefschetz claim; no new Zenodo publication. Distinct from PR195 / 30004601 / OWR-4990374-004 / DOI10.5281/zenodo.23395703 (higher-dimensional gin counterexample).
